# SurajWood — Complete Technical & Product Reference (LLMs Full)

## Executive Summary
Suraj Wood Products Pvt. Ltd. (established 2011) is India's leading manufacturer of high-end architectural surfaces and furniture components. Operating an automated plant in Bahadurgarh (Haryana), SurajWood supplies prelaminated PMMA acrylic panels, 3D seamless vacuum-thermoformed membrane shutters, decorative laminates, and AL-PROFHAN 6063-T5 architectural aluminum profiles across 50+ Indian cities.

---

## 1. Prelaminated PMMA Acrylic Panels
- **Material Chemistry**: Pure extruded PMMA (Polymethyl Methacrylate) 1.0mm–1.5mm top layer. Unlike PET or PETG plastics, PMMA provides superior molecular density, 3H scratch hardness, zero orange-peel ripple, and complete UV stability with zero yellowing.
- **PUR Hot-Melt Bonding**: Bonded under continuous roller press using reactive polyurethane (PUR) adhesive at 120°C. PUR forms an irreversible covalent cross-link with wood fibers, rendering the bond 100% waterproof and boil-proof.
- **Product Range**:
  - **ACRYLUX**: 95%+ High Gloss mirror-finish acrylic panels (37+ solid, metallic, and wood finishes).
  - **ACRYSILK**: Soft-satin anti-fingerprint acrylic panels with velvet tactile touch.
  - **ACRYMATTE**: Super matte anti-glare nano-treated acrylic boards.
  - **ACRYGLASS / ACRYGLASS MATTE**: 2mm crystal-clarity glass-effect acrylic panels.
- **Substrates**: E1-Grade Low-Formaldehyde MDF, Calibrated Multi-Ply Marine/BWP Plywood, Particle Board (PB).
- **Standard Dimensions**: 2440mm × 1220mm (8ft × 4ft); Thicknesses: 8mm, 18mm, 25mm.

---

## 2. 3D Seamless Membrane Shutters & Doors
- **Manufacturing Process**: 3D Positive & Negative Vacuum Thermoforming Press at 120°C.
- **Monolithic Edge Wrap**: The polymer foil wraps smoothly around the front face and all 4 side edges in a single monolithic sheet. Eliminates separate edge banding, glue-line discoloration, and edge peeling in high-steam environments.
- **Core Substrate**: Green HDHMR (High Density High Moisture Resistance) with 850+ kg/m³ density, providing maximum screw retention and zero core swelling.
- **36 Curated European Finishes**:
  - **Wood Grain (WG - 9 shades)**: Casella Oak Nature, Casella Oak Helle, Smoked Walnut, Marone Oak, Natural Pine.
  - **Porcelain Touch (PT - 13 shades)**: Alpin Weiß, Cashmere, Macchiato, Monument Grey, Basalt Grey, Shadow Black.
  - **Perfect Silk (PS - 7 shades)**: Frost White, Kaschmir, Rusty Red, Reed Green, Estate Green, Graphite, Carbone Grey.
  - **Ceramic Satin (CS - 7 shades)**: Bianco Statuario, Grigio Orobico, Nero Marquina, Travertino, Cemento.
- **CNC Routing Profiles**:
  - Classic Shaker Doors (timeless recessed center panel with 90° or 45° step-down).
  - Integrated J-Pull Handleless (continuous ergonomically routed finger-grip channel).
  - Fluted & Ribbed 3D Panels (rhythmic vertical architectural textures).
  - Beveled & Chamfered Edge Profiles.

---

## 3. AL-PROFHAN Architectural Aluminum Profiles
- **Alloy Grade**: 6063-T5 Architectural Extrusion Alloy (Tensile Strength ≥ 215 MPa, Yield Strength ≥ 170 MPa, Webster Hardness 10–12).
- **Wall Thickness Gauge**: Calibrated 1.2mm to 1.5mm heavy-duty gauge to eliminate sagging across 3000mm continuous spans.
- **Standard Length**: 3.00-meter (10 ft) continuous lengths.
- **Surface Finishes**: Anodized Black Brush (15–20µ), Anodized Bronze Brush, Coffee Painted (powder-coated), Anthracite Painted, Champagne Painted.
- **Series Breakdown**:
  - **Ottimo Series**: Handleless Gola systems (PAPS-5220 L-shutter with gasket damper groove, PAPS-5221 C-shutter, PAPS-5311 Wall Gola, PAPS-5313 3-side profile) + color-matched zinc-alloy end caps.
  - **Aerolinea Series**: Ultra-slim glass door profiles (PAPS-6631, PAPS-6632) and architectural T-patti edge trims (PAPS-6634).
  - **Handle Profiles**: Heavy J-pull (PAPS-1336, PAPS-5677) and L-profile handles (PAPS-1335).
  - **Shelf Profiles**: Integrated LED illuminated glass shelf extrusion (PAPS-5037, PAPS-5037A).
  - **Hanging Rod**: High-capacity LED wardrobe hanging rod (PAPS-6413) with clothes hanging brackets (PACP-6414).
  - **Luminare Series**: 45° corner diffuser (PAPS-3136A) and recessed under-cabinet lighting channels (PAPS-3062A).
  - **Velaro Series**: Premium sliding and fixed glass shutter profiles (PAPS-1351A) with 128mm handles (PAHD-1351C) and 90° steel corner connectors (PACN-1351A).

---

## 4. Decorative Laminates & Surface Solutions
- High-pressure decorative laminates (HPL) with synchronized wood grains, matte solid colors, and anti-bacterial surfaces for heavy-duty commercial, hospital, and retail applications.

---

## Comprehensive Material Comparison Table

| Feature / Property | SurajWood PMMA Acrylic | SurajWood 3D Membrane | Traditional HPL Laminate | PU / Polyurethane Paint |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Edge Construction** | Precision Laser / PUR Edge-Banded | **100% Monolithic 5-Sided Seamless Wrap** | 90° Glued Edge Banding | Sprayed Edges (Chipping Prone) |
| **Surface Hardness** | 3H Pencil Hardness | Resilient 0.45mm Polymer | 1H - 2H Standard | Low (Fragile to Scratches) |
| **3D CNC Grooving** | Flat Panels Only | **Yes (Shaker, J-Pull, Fluted)** | Flat Panels Only | Yes (Labor Intensive) |
| **Steam & Water Seal** | 100% Waterproof PUR Bond | **100% Continuous Polymer Seal** | Glue line vulnerable to moisture | Moderate |
| **Optical Clarity** | Mirror-Like (95%+ Gloss) | Tactile Matte / Wood Grain | Flat / Textured | Variable |
| **Warranty** | 5–10 Years | 5 Years | 1–2 Years | No Warranty |
